assignment: Review GetProductHourlySalesAsync against TopSelling/SoldProducts, trace its date/status filters, callers, DTO and tests. Determine whether it changes the conditional status/range assessment. Static only; no tests/runtime changes.

current_receipt.use: Stable identity/status only; this handoff records source-specific review.

source_reasoning.behavior: Calls the shared Range(from,to), selects OrderItems AsNoTracking joined to Orders by OrderId, filters Status != nameof(OrderStatus.Cancelled) plus optional CreatedAtUtc bounds, and materializes ProductName, Quantity, TotalPricePiastres and CreatedAtUtc. In memory it converts each timestamp to Cairo local time, groups by ProductName and 0-23 local hour, sums quantity and stored line total, and sorts by product then hour. Read-only, no accounting write or current-product/category lookup.
source_reasoning.grouping_and_money: The key is exactly the ProductName used by GetTopSellingItemsAsync and GetSoldProductsAsync; same-name product IDs coalesce by documented panel semantics. ProductHourlySalesDto.TotalPiastres sums order-line totals, not cash collected, refunds or order-level discount. DailyStatement UI shows quantity/hour; the API also carries the line amount. No net-accounting conclusion is drawn from this analytical slice.
source_reasoning.date_behavior: Same shared Range helper as the two preceding methods. Both bounds mean a Cairo business-date half-open interval. A lone from is open-ended into the future; lone to includes all earlier dates through that date; inverted ranges are not explicitly rejected. The direct `/api/reports/product-hourly` endpoint accepts optional bounds. The ReportsViewModel sends its resolved range bounds; DailyStatementQueryService passes businessDate as both from and to. Thus the one-sided discrepancy remains an API-contract ambiguity for direct callers but is not exercised by the inspected UI paths.
source_reasoning.status_behavior: Same `Status != nameof(OrderStatus.Cancelled)` predicate as TopSelling and SoldProducts. OrderEnumMapping persists `cancelled` lowercase, while nameof is `Cancelled`. Result therefore depends on SQL collation. The prior SoldProducts handoff's cancellation test source asserts sold products disappear, but does not assert ProductHourly rows after cancellation; the ProductHourly tests exercise normal orders only. This review does not run tests or establish actual production collation.

cross_file_evidence.behavior: DailyStatement GetAsync receives one businessDate and passes it in both from and to positions to GetProductHourlySalesAsync.
GET /api/reports/product-hourly accepts nullable from/to, applies RequireReportsAccessAsync, and returns the report list. Permission helper requires reports_view or all.
DTO describes Hour as 0-23 Cairo wall time and sparse active-hour rows; record fields are ProductName, Hour, Quantity and TotalPiastres.
Client calls the direct product-hourly endpoint with actorUserId/from/to and deserializes rows.
Reports screen resolves selected range, passes it to API, then BuildProductHours groups returned records by ProductName for UI display.
The daily-statement view groups rows by product name, totals quantity and presents peak label/hour cells; it ignores monetary TotalPiastres for this panel.

comparison_to_prior_handoffs.conclusion: Confirms the identical status predicate, Range helper and ProductName key. It adds no contrary evidence on status collation; direct tests for top-items cancellation are absent.

Confirms the same date/status/grouping semantics. SoldProducts has a test-source cancellation assertion; ProductHourly has no cancellation assertion after the cancel operation, so its test coverage is weaker. Its actual daily-statement caller still uses a single explicit day.

tests.coverage: Normal sale has expected Cairo local hour, quantity one, hour within 0-23, and no duplicate (ProductName, Hour) keys.
Explicit two-date range includes today sale and a prior-day-only range is empty. Does not test one-sided dates, exact boundary instants, cancellation, refunds, discount, or DST transition.
Normal two-bound day range returns hourly amount; sales endpoint shift filters are checked separately.

related_cancellation_test.coverage: After cancellation, asserts SoldProducts excludes item but does not assert ProductHourly excludes it.

conditional_notes: Case-sensitive SQL collation could include cancelled rows because persisted lowercase and query PascalCase differ. Existing SoldProducts test is relevant but not a ProductHourly assertion, and no collation/runtime evidence was checked. Keep conditional, not confirmed.
One-sided date behavior is unchanged. Current WPF ReportsViewModel passes both bounds and DailyStatement passes the same date twice, but endpoint contract remains open to partial queries.
Gross line TotalPiastres remains an analytical product/hour metric, not net cash; no defect follows absent a requirement that it be netted.
recommendations: If hardening the shared filter, compare against the lowercase persisted wire value or centralize query-safe status values across all sibling report methods, and retain direct cancellation tests for top-items, sold-products, hourly and category reports.
Document or normalize partial date semantics and test one-sided/inverted requests if those are supported public API inputs.
assessment.runtime_limits: Static review only; SQL collation and actual endpoint behavior are unverified.

limitations: This is supplemental evidence, not global financial coverage certification.
